resources.string: Choose two languages and start the conversation. Take turns speaking when the microphone is active. Read the translation here; use the speaker button to turn speech output on or off.
Choose the languages, enter your text and tap the translation button.
Prepare the languages once over Wi‑Fi to translate offline. The download size may not be known in advance.

Preparing selected language models over Wi‑Fi…
Prepare the selected language models once over validated Wi‑Fi. They will then be available offline.
A validated Wi‑Fi connection is required. Reconnect and retry.
Model preparation took too long. The provider download may continue; retry to check again.
The language model could not be prepared. Retry.
Translation failed. Your input was kept; retry.

Could not open the conversation. Your saved languages are shown above. Restart the app to try opening the conversation again.
Could not safely stop the previous conversation. Restart the app before changing languages or preparing or starting a conversation.
Preparation incomplete. Check your connection and storage, then retry.
Microphone permission is needed. Tap Start conversation to retry, or enable the permission in app settings.
Speech skipped: %1$d. Please wait for the current turn, then repeat.
Could not save the speech output choice. The current conversation keeps its selected output state.
Conversation continues without speech output. Stop the conversation before preparing voices or opening settings.
This turn could not be completed
Languages are missing or damaged. Prepare languages again.
Speech or voices could not start. Stop and try again; prepare languages if the error persists.
The microphone is unavailable. Close other recording apps, then start again.
Recording failed. Check microphone access, then start again.
This language is not selected for conversation. Please repeat in a selected language.
Could not determine the language. Please repeat.
Speech could not be recognized. Please repeat clearly.
Translation failed. Your recognized words are kept; please repeat.
The translation could not be played. Its text is kept. Check audio output, then try again.
Translation stays on this device. The app does not create a history of your text.
The saved language is unavailable. Choose a supported language.
The saved translation provider is unavailable. Choose an installed provider.
The provider does not support this language pair.
A saved speech model is unavailable. Choose an available model.
The selected model does not match its role or language.
A selected conversation language has no supported voice.
Silence must be between 300 and 1500 milliseconds.
Voice speed must be between 75 and 125 percent.
Stop the current operation before changing translation or speech settings.
The settings file was damaged. Safe defaults were restored; review and apply your choices.
Settings could not be loaded. Retry before making changes.
Settings could not be saved. Your draft was kept. Retry.
One choice for Text and Conversation. You can change it in Settings. Choosing does not download models or use the microphone.
Quality priority · Tencent. May take longer and needs more storage and memory.
Both can make mistakes. These are priorities, not a guarantee of speed or quality on your device.
Both selected languages need speech support for conversation. Installed resources and offline voice readiness are checked separately after selection.
This pair is available for text translation, but conversation needs speech support for both languages.
Could not open text translation. The saved pair is shown above. Restart the app to try again.
Could not safely release the previous operation. Restart the app before changing languages or preparing translation.
A selected language has no installed offline system voice. Install local voice data, then recheck.
No system speech engine is available. Install an engine and local voices for the selected languages, then recheck.
The system speech engine could not initialize. Recheck the selected engine and its installed local voices.
The selected speech engine could not open its voice installation screen. Recheck the engine and its local voice data.
Restores Tencent translation for Text and Conversation, Whisper speech recognition, and system offline speech output. Your translation languages and interface language stay unchanged.
The previous runtime could not stop safely. Nothing was saved. Restart the app before applying settings.
Selected offline recognition models are ready.
An offline recognition model is missing. Prepare the selected languages.
Android offline recognition does not support this pair. No other engine is chosen automatically.
Android on-device recognition is unavailable. No cloud or other engine is used.
Android download scheduled. Not ready yet; recheck when it finishes.
Android is downloading recognition models. Wait, then recheck.
Recognition download failed. Check your connection and retry preparation.
Recognition check failed. Recheck before starting.
Could not change the interface language. Select it again to retry.
ML Kit uses Google Translate for on-device translation. The link below describes Google attribution requirements.
Loading and warming up local translation…
The translation model is missing or damaged. Prepare offline translation again.
The model could not be stored or downloaded. Check free space and Wi‑Fi, then prepare again.
The local translation engine could not load. Prepare again; restart the app if it persists.
Not enough memory for local translation. Close other apps and prepare again, or choose a shorter text.
The text exceeds the local translation context or output limit. Shorten the source; no partial translation was kept.
The source contains invalid Unicode. Correct the text and retry.
Translation preparation took too long. Check the preparation state and retry.

Tencent Hy-MT2 uses one 1.13 GB model for all languages, downloaded only with Prepare over Wi‑Fi. Local initialization also needs Prepare after reopening. It can require several GB of memory; translation quality and phone performance are not qualified.
The selected recognition service is not qualified for offline conversation. Choose a compatible service in advanced settings.

Install the missing language, then return to recheck readiness.
The selected recognition service is unavailable. Choose an installed service in advanced settings.
